card.hypothesis: Near-target inertia-reversed ABC labels or mixed RGB/OCT rendering provenance contribute to A reversal and late drift.
card.main_change: One audit-selected repair branch only; B has priority over A.
card.original_pool: All valid unmodified merged training windows, 92%
card.correction_pool: Independent repaired windows (A) or 50 same-observation training-target trajectories (B), 8%

evaluation_protocol.strict_success: error<0.35um and 3 settled frames, diagnostic only
evaluation_protocol.drift: final post1600 error minus pre-action trace[1000] error; signed mean gates, absolute mean also reported

card.branch_rule: A if A or B direction-conflict >=20% of all-bucket eligible nonzero zero/pre-acceleration teacher frames; B if old A reverse<=3/9 and new>=7/9 plus provenance mismatch or increased boundary median. B priority.
card.direction_gate: A reverse<=1/9 and toward>75% and fast5 signed late drift<15um
card.dev20_gate: Best complete fast5 finalmean<35um and signed late drift<15um

collection.targets: First50 eligible training plan2 episodes, frozen before launch, excluding development targets
collection.start: First source valid150-200um frame; if absent first valid<200um frame

card.reuse: Only complete per-task receipts with matching frozen inputs/code and evidence hashes; no failed-stage automatic retries.
card.simulation_scope: Software/MuJoCo only; no clinical or hardware readiness claims.
